run_f_gold_maximum_average_path: run f_gold to compute the maximum average value path through an N by N cost grid
test_f_gold_with_test_cases: test f_gold against the built-in test cases comparing results to a filled implementation
create_dp_grid_path_solver: create a dynamic programming solution to find the maximum sum path from top-left to bottom-right in a grid
refactor_f_gold_for_efficiency: refactor f_gold to reduce space complexity from O(N squared) to O(N) using a single row DP array
summarize_f_gold_algorithm: summarize the f_gold function which uses DP to find max path sum then divides by path length
